_readme: OPT-IN Code Puppy accessibility auto-fix hook for @walmart/ld-kit.
Code Puppy is a best-effort / experimental runtime for this loop -- see
scripts/a11y/README.md -> 'Code Puppy (experimental, interactive-only)'.
TO ENABLE:
1. Copy the "hooks" block below into ~/.code_puppy/hooks.json
(create the file, or merge into your existing PreToolUse array).
2. Restart Code Puppy (it loads hook config once at startup).
3. Use the interactive TUI -- headless `code-puppy -p` fires no hooks.
WHY THIS ISN'T SHIPPED ACTIVE:
Code Puppy's only project-level config is the shared .claude/settings.json
(also read by Claude Code). Adding a PreToolUse hook there would make
Claude Code scan before every edit (regression), and the timeout unit
conflicts (Code Puppy reads ms; Claude reads seconds). The clean Code-Puppy
-only location is the per-machine global ~/.code_puppy/hooks.json, which a
per-project starter cannot ship -- hence this copy-me example.
GOTCHAS baked into the config below:
- matcher MUST be bare "*" -- Code Puppy reads any leading-dot pattern
(e.g. ".*") as a FILE-EXTENSION match, so ".*" never matches a tool.
- timeout is in MILLISECONDS (min 100); 55000 = 55s.
- invoke via `node` (not `npm run`) so the npm banner can't corrupt the
stdout {decision:block} JSON that Code Puppy parses.
- engine PATH: defaults to the relative scripts/a11y/run-endhook.mjs (Code
Puppy runs the hook with cwd = the project root you launched from, same
convention as every other runtime). This is model-agnostic -- it does not
depend on the model you pick. Override it for a non-standard layout by
exporting LD_A11Y_ENGINE=/abs/path/to/run-endhook.mjs before launching.
- the `test -f ... || true` guard makes it a safe no-op in projects that
don't have the ld-kit a11y engine.
